title: 1556 Shaanxi earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1556 Shaanxi earthquake", at revision 1370898423, opens: "One of the deadliest earthquakes in history occurred in the early morning of 23 January 1556 in Huaxian, Shaanxi, during the Ming dynasty." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q191293, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Magnitude 8 Earthquake (23 Janaury 1556) in Shaanxi, China; regarded as deadliest earthquake in recorded history". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
